rust_summary: the local player's right click on empty space with an empty hand (`native_right_click_empty`).
doc_summary: the local player's right click on empty space with an empty hand, NeoForge's `PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickEmpty`: `native_right_click_empty(hand)` is heard on the client for each empty hand `Minecraft.startUseItem` tries, main hand first, when no entity or block is in the crosshair. The server never hears of the click; a mod that needs it there sends its own message. It cannot be cancelled. Bundles need "hooks": @API:right_click_empty@.
